purpose: Isolate full JSON Schema compilation while holding the remaining request constant
requires: Subsequent explicit user authorization and current free-quota confirmation
only_request_change: omit generationConfig.responseJsonSchema; retain application/json and all other fields
http200_would_show: The same policy, reasoning, API version and JSON mode can be accepted without the full schema, in that attempt only
http400_would_show: A rejection persists without the full schema; only new allowlisted structured error fields may locate the bad argument
does_not_prove: Historical causal attribution, full-schema support, B/C semantic quality or scientific selection
